nodes.description: Ownable state variable owner (address public owner) in contract Owned; holds the privileged account address.
State variable newOwner in contract Owned used for the two-step ownership transfer handshake.
ERC20 token symbol string, initialised to 'FWF' in the FreshWaterFlow constructor.
ERC20 token name string, initialised to 'Fresh Water Flow' in the FreshWaterFlow constructor.
ERC20 decimals uint8, set to 18 in the FreshWaterFlow constructor.
Total token supply state variable set to 1500000000000 in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances of every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) performing checked addition via require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) performing checked subtraction via require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) performing multiply with overflow guard require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) performing division guarded by require(b > 0).
Constructor of contract Owned that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner for the two-step ownership transfer.
Function completing ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, sets owner = newOwner and newOwner = address(0).
Token constructor setting symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and assigning the whole supply to 0xd821C73d82E6221655637361949AE2f88aCE3Ba7.
ERC20 totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unguarded subtraction.
ERC20 balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer(address to, uint tokens) moving tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emitting Transfer.
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint tokens) writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emitting Approval (no double-spend check by design).
ERC20 transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) debiting balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], crediting balances[to].
ERC20 allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender used in the Owned constructor to set the owner address.
msg.sender used inside the onlyOwner modifier's require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check.
msg.sender used in acceptOwnership's require(msg.sender == newOwner) ownership check.
msg.sender used in transfer as the address whose balance is debited.
msg.sender used in approve as the allowance owner key.
msg.sender used in transferFrom as the spender whose allowance is debited.
msg.sender forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
Raw addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Raw subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Raw multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Raw division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Unguarded arithmetic subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] returned by totalSupply(); can underflow with no SafeMath guard.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made by approveAndCall before returning; allows arbitrary caller-controlled code execution.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) made by transferAnyERC20Token against a caller-supplied contract address.
